description_en: Retrieves the details of a specified sensitive field in Data Security Guard
description_zh: 调用QueryRecognizeRuleDetail接口查询数据保护伞的指定敏感字段详情
name: QueryRecognizeRuleDetail

parameters.help_en: The name of the sensitive field. To obtain the name of the sensitive field, call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2747189.html operation or log on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and go to the Data Category and Sensitivity Level page
parameters.help_zh: 敏感字段名称。可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2747189.html接口，或进入DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，在数据保护伞的分类分级界面获取敏感字段名称
parameters.name: sensitive_name

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. To obtain the tenant ID, perform the following steps: Log on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console). Find your workspace and go to the DataStudio page. On the DataStudio page, click the logon username in the upper-right corner and click User Info in the Menu section
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID。您可登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入数据开发（DataStudio）页面，单击右上方当前登录用户名称，选择菜单 > 用户信息，获取租户ID
parameters.name: tenant_id
